# Learning Record Template

```yaml
id: LRN-XXX
title: <learning title>
type: learning-record
version: 1.0
status: active
owner: <engineer>
created: YYYY-MM-DD
updated: YYYY-MM-DD
review_frequency: on-change
depends_on: []
implements: []
related_documents: []
supersedes: []
tags: [learning, <domain>]
```

## Context

What happened? What was the situation?

## Discovery

What was learned? What was surprising?

## Root Cause

Why did this happen?

## Impact

What was the effect on the system, team, or customers?

## Action Taken

What was done to resolve or address the situation?

## Lessons Learned

What should be done differently in the future?

- Standards to update:

## Traceability

- First Principles: <which principles>
- Standards: <which standards>
- Lifecycle: <which lifecycle stages>
